title: Astrid and the Inventory
author: Xanthe Dunmore
blurb: Jonah Nystrom, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
